title: StockSmart Training Questions — Emergency Machine Restocks and Safety Cover on a Transferred Item
content:
**Rule.** For the fill-to level of a new consigned bin under the StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program that takes over an item the customer has had taken out of one of its VendPoint Industrial Vending Program machines, emergency restocks of that item at that machine in the last three months add safety cover weeks: 2 or more add 1 week, exactly 1 adds 0.5 week, and none adds none.

**Q. Which restocks count?** Restocks of the transferred item, made as emergency restocks, at the machine it was removed from at the customer's request. Restocks at any other machine, of any other item, or made on a routine visit do not count.

**Q. What are the last three months?** Rows of age below three, a row's age in whole months being the number of calendar months from its date to today, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than the row's day of the month.

**Q. A hypothetical item had 3 emergency restocks at that machine in the window. What is added?** 1 week, the same as for 2.

**Q. And with exactly 1?** 0.5 week. With none, nothing is added.

| Emergency restocks in the last three months | Safety cover weeks added |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 1 week |
| exactly 1 | 0.5 week |
| none | none |
